units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 85a:4">B. Kam. 85ᵃ</cite> (speaking of how much a man would take for allowing his hand to be cut off) <he>בש׳ עסקינן</he> do we treat of idiots (who but an idiot would do such a thing)? <cite ref="Bava Metzia 40a:15">B. Mets. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>וכי בש׳ וכ׳</he> do we speak of idiots who lend on large measure and take back on small measure? <cite ref="Bava Batra 122a:10">B. Bath. 122ᵃ</cite> <he>אטו בש׳ וכ׳</he> do we speak of idiots (that will part with their landed heirloom for money)?—V. <cite ref="U01011"><he>שִׁיפּוּט</he></cite>.
